# E0313: no such field

Check the field's name against the type's declaration. A `Shared<T>`'s fields are read inside `when`, and a field read through an `Option` is the field of the value inside it.

- Rule: [`types.field-access`](../../reference/07-types.md#types.field-access)
- Reported at: the field's name.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `types` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0313:3
type Order = { id: i64, total: i64 }

fn amount(o: Order) -> i64 { o.totl }
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
type Order = { id: i64, total: i64 }

fn amount(o: Order) -> i64 { o.total }
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0313_field_of_a_shared_value.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0313_field_of_a_shared_value.lt):

```text
── NO SUCH FIELD ───────────────── E0313_field_of_a_shared_value.lt:6:5  [E0313]

`Shared<Account>` has no field `balance`: its value is reached only inside a
`when` that names it:

  6 │   a.balance
    │     ^^^^^^^

Check the field's name against the type's declaration. A `Shared<T>`'s fields
are read inside `when`, and a field read through an `Option` is the field of the
value inside it.

To fix it, read it inside `when a`:

  6 │   when a { a.balance }
    │   +++++++++         ++
```

`stilt check` on [`E0313_length_field.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0313_length_field.lt):

```text
── NO SUCH FIELD ─────────────────────────── E0313_length_field.lt:3:14  [E0313]

`List<{integer}>` has no field `length`; a length is the method `len()`:

  3 │   print("{xs.length}")
    │              ^^^^^^

Strings, lists, arrays, maps and sets have a `len` method.

To fix it, call `len()`:

  3 │   print("{xs.len()}")
    │              ~~~~~
```

To fix it, write `total`:
